purpose: Author the molding shop guide from its operation records and schematic drawing primitives.
title: Mold operations
subtitle: Shop guide - silicone funnel and three cold-core foam pours

extra.qualification_scope: Illustrated shop sequence; physical acceptance remains with the identified tooling and materials.

pages.title: Make the soft parts
pages.subtitle: Silicone funnel + two foam caps + one body pour. A picture for each bench move.

actions.title: Funnel: pages 2-16
actions.body: Finish the printed tooling, prove the material stack, cast, open and inspect the removable funnel.

actions.title: Cold core: pages 17-22
actions.body: Two cap pours bolted to the shell's top face, then the body pour through its open top. Each mixes 1:1.

result.title: USE THIS AT THE BENCH
result.body: Coral marks the current move. Blue marks gauges, air paths and surfaces to keep clear. Pictures are schematic; named dimensions govern.

pages.source: Scope: funnel-mold/README.md; cold-core.md steps 3, 5-7

pages.title: Stage the casting bench
pages.subtitle: Lay out the whole job before silicone A meets silicone B.

actions.title: Tooling + closure
actions.body: Cavity, core, stock steel rod, eight M4 x 20 bolts, 9 mm OD washers and nuts; a sharp blade for cured flash.

actions.title: Liquids + handling
actions.body: BBDINO 40A A/B, compatible black pigment, scale, cups, sticks, release, catch tray, vacuum chamber and pump.

actions.title: Dry, ventilated work
actions.body: Read the container instructions. Wear eye protection and appropriate gloves; keep release spray away from ignition sources.

result.title: READY
result.body: Room, materials and tooling are at the recorded batch temperature. The open mold and catch tray fit through the actual chamber opening.

pages.source: Tooling: funnel-mold/README.md. Release: Smooth-On ER200 instructions.

pages.title: Finish the forming faces
pages.subtitle: The coating allowance belongs to the forming surfaces. The parting lands remain bare.

drawing.value: also mask: locators, rod guides and axial stops

actions.title: Clear supports and open infill
actions.body: Remove bolt-pocket supports. Drill 1.5 mm dry-side breathers: cavity sides 3.2 mm deep, core flat back 1.8 mm deep. Positions: mold README.

actions.title: Measure a witness
actions.body: Use the actual PETG, sanding and finish stack on a sample. Measure net growth; the shell reserve is 0.30 mm normal to the face.

actions.title: Mask closure datums
actions.body: Keep lands, pegs/holes, bolt bores, rod guides and end stops bare. Coated lands change closure height.

result.title: BEFORE CONTINUING
result.body: The finish is dry and coherent, and the coated halves still close on the bare lands. Coating compatibility and closure need a physical check.

pages.source: Funnel-mold/README.md: forming surfaces and fit; print-log.md

pages.title: Prepare the steel rod
pages.subtitle: One stock 6 mm x 25 mm rod forms the entire straight outlet bore.

actions.title: Select the stock rod
actions.body: Use the specified smooth 6 mm x 25 mm stainless dowel. Its factory end chamfers stay outside the silicone forming span.

actions.title: Clean the cylinder
actions.body: Remove oil and debris, then dry. Keep the cylindrical surface smooth and free of dents or raised burrs.

actions.title: Apply release
actions.body: Apply the same light release film used on the mold. Keep the rod and both printed guides clean for a loose drop-in fit.

result.title: READY
result.body: The straight rod slides through the open core guide and rests on the cavity's lower floor. Its upper end stays visible.

pages.source: Funnel-mold/README.md: stock rod and open guide

pages.title: Prove the material stack
pages.subtitle: A small same-stack witness protects the first full casting.

drawing.value: actual 40A silicone + actual pigment on each actual contact stack
cure, then peel and inspect the contact face

actions.title: Make the witness representative
actions.body: Use the actual shell PETG and finish, steel rod, release and silicone batch. Include the planned pigment concentration.

actions.title: Keep the stack clean
actions.body: Use clean cups, tools and contact surfaces. Test the exact finishing products and pigment that will touch this platinum-cure silicone.

actions.title: Inspect after cure
actions.body: The rubber must cure at the contact face and release without tack, tearing or coating transfer. Record that result before the full cast.

result.title: HOLD IF GUMMY
result.body: A firm outer surface can hide inhibited rubber at the tool. Cure/release compatibility has no accepted full-tool record yet.

pages.source: Funnel-mold/README.md; Smooth-On sealer/release reference

pages.title: Drop in the steel rod
pages.subtitle: The open core guide leads the rod into the cavity's lower floor seat.

drawing.value: open guide allows air and small silicone overflow

actions.title: Close the empty mold
actions.body: Seat the locators and bare flange lands. The core guide must align with the cavity's lower seat.

actions.title: Drop the rod through the guide
actions.body: Lower the stock rod from the open dry back. It rests on the lower floor, 1.5 mm below the block-bottom face.

actions.title: Check free movement
actions.body: Lift the rod and let it settle again without pressing. The upper end projects about 4.2 mm above the guide.

result.title: READY
result.body: The mold closes on its bare lands independently of rod length. Clear support residue if the rod catches.

pages.source: Funnel-mold/README.md: straight rod and open guide

pages.title: Dry-close the mold
pages.subtitle: Bring the bare parting lands together before adding liquid.

drawing.value: bolt order schematic; actual asymmetric locators set orientation

actions.title: Locate without force
actions.body: The asymmetric short pegs establish drain orientation. One mating hole is slotted to accommodate spacing error.

actions.title: Close opposite stations
actions.body: Use eight bolts, washers and nuts or small clamps on the flat flange backs. Tighten incrementally until bare lands meet.

actions.title: Backlight the seam
actions.body: Check closure with the steel rod resting on the lower floor. Reopen for release and filling after this dry fit succeeds.

result.title: CHECK
result.body: The bare flange lands meet, the rod rests on its lower floor, and the open upper guide leaves its end accessible.

pages.source: Funnel-mold/README.md: closure; print-log.md: physical evidence scope

pages.title: Apply a light release film
pages.subtitle: A thin, dry, continuous film reaches the small wet features too.

actions.title: Clean and shake
actions.body: Use a suitable cleaner for the proven finish stack. Shake Ease Release 200 well; spray with ventilation and eye/skin protection.

actions.title: Mist from 6-8 inches
actions.body: Apply lightly, brush over fine details and add a second light mist. Coat the steel rod lightly; keep the guide and fill/vent holes open.

actions.title: Let it dry
actions.body: Recheck bare closure datums, rod guides and port openings. Apply a light fresh release film before each cast.

result.title: RELEASE CHECK
result.body: The same-stack witness must already have passed. Spray application does not establish compatibility, cleanability or finished food-contact acceptance.

pages.source: Smooth-On Ease Release 200 instructions + sealer/release reference

pages.title: Measure, color and mix
pages.subtitle: BBDINO 40A uses equal A and B. Choose one measurement basis for the whole batch.

drawing.value: about {{silicone_mass_g}} g rubber + ports and mixing allowance

actions.title: Set a batch quantity
actions.body: Nominal geometry is {{funnel_volume_ml}} mL. The ~1.13 g/mL material estimate gives ~{{silicone_mass_g}} g in the casting; allow extra for fill ports and mixing loss.

actions.title: Weigh the pigment
actions.body: Use the actual BBDINO platinum-compatible black. Project limit: at most 2% by weight. Include it in the same-stack cure/release witness.

actions.title: Mix the measured components
actions.body: Scrape the cup wall and bottom until uniform. Start the working-time clock when A and B meet; no unmixed streaks remain.

result.title: BATCH CLOCK
result.body: Maker working time: 30 min at 23 C. Record room and liquid temperature; warmer conditions shorten the window. Follow the supplied batch instructions.

pages.source: Funnel silicone.md; design.json; BBDINO 40A manufacturer product page

pages.title: Degas the mixed silicone
pages.subtitle: This 40A grade requires degassing. Give the rising foam room above the liquid.

drawing.value: headroom above actual batch / catch tray below

actions.title: Choose an ample cup
actions.body: Mixed silicone rises during evacuation. Use a larger container or split the batch if the available cup cannot contain the froth.

actions.title: Evacuate under control
actions.body: Degas in a separate container with expansion space. Observe the rise and collapse; control the valve to prevent overflow.

actions.title: Vent and pour while fluid
actions.body: Vent slowly, remove the cup and continue the casting sequence within the measured working-time window.

result.title: USE THE ACTUAL EQUIPMENT INSTRUCTIONS
result.body: The guide supplies no universal vacuum setpoint or timer. Follow the chamber/pump and silicone batch instructions; watch the material.

pages.source: Funnel-mold/README.md; BBDINO 40A; Smooth-On degassing example

pages.title: Fill, lower, then top up
pages.subtitle: Set the rod in the lower seat, fill the open cavity, then lower the core slowly over it.

drawing.value: small guide overflow trims after cure
3  Top up: 11 mm fill / 5 x 4 mm vents open

actions.title: Seat the rod, then fill
actions.body: Set the steel rod on the lower seat floor. Fill around the rod and drain block while the degassed silicone still flows.

actions.title: Seat the core evenly
actions.body: Lower slowly over the rod. Let air escape through the open rod guide; close the bare flange lands without force.

actions.title: Top up through the fill hole
actions.body: Use the 11 mm fill opening. The five 4 mm vents, rod access and dry-side infill breathers remain open; catch overflow.

result.title: CHECK
result.body: The parting lands remain closed, the rod stays seated, and liquid reaches the block and continuous 6 mm ramp space. No pressure injection.

pages.source: Funnel-mold/README.md: cast and open, steps 2-3

pages.title: Cycle the filled mold gently
pages.subtitle: If using a filled-mold vacuum cycle, the whole tool shares the chamber pressure.

drawing.value: fill + vents + rod access + infill breathers open
catch tray / overflow clear of pressure paths

actions.title: Keep openings connected
actions.body: Check the assembled mold and catch tray through the chamber's actual opening. Keep fill, vents, rod access and drilled breathers open.

actions.title: Evacuate and vent slowly
actions.body: Perform any cycle while silicone is fluid. Observe tool/overflow behavior, vent gently, then recheck and top up the fill level.

actions.title: Return to ambient for cure
actions.body: Keep the flanges held together through room-temperature cure. The tooling is not rated for a sealed atmosphere differential.

result.title: KEEP PRESSURE PATHS OPEN
result.body: Liquid head is about 0.6 kPa. Six walls and 15% gyroid rely on open infill breathers during slow vacuum cycling. Stop on distortion or a blocked path.

pages.source: Funnel-mold/README.md: load and vacuum; cast and open step 4

pages.title: Hold the flanges through cure
pages.subtitle: Leave the tool undisturbed at ambient pressure while the silicone develops its cure.

actions.title: Log time and temperature
actions.body: Record A/B mixing start, pour finish, room/liquid temperature and batch identity. Warmer and cooler shops change the cure window.

actions.title: Use the conservative project hold
actions.body: Project material record uses 5 h before demold at 23 C and 24 h before full use. Check the supplied batch insert and cured witness.

actions.title: Keep the tool assembled
actions.body: Maintain ambient pressure and closed flanges. Leave the casting and steel rod seated until their contact surfaces have cured.

result.title: CURE IS NOT FOOD-CONTACT RELEASE
result.body: The manufacturer's direct page lists 3 h; the project holds 5 h conservatively. No qualified post-cure bake schedule is established.

pages.source: Funnel silicone.md; BBDINO direct page checked 04 Oct 2026

pages.title: Open in small movements
pages.subtitle: Free the core first; keep the casting and steel rod together while peeling from the cavity.

drawing.value: lift core straight off the steel rod
peel accessible brim to admit air

actions.title: Clear the opening points
actions.body: Trim overflow at port mouths and remove the flange bolts or clamps. Keep the casting supported while freeing the core.

actions.title: Alternate opening points
actions.body: Use a blunt tool at opposing edge notches, moving a little at a time. Peel accessible silicone brim to let air enter.

actions.title: Lift, then peel
actions.body: Lift the core straight off the rod. Peel the casting and rod together from the cavity; support the drain block.

result.title: STOP ON STICKING
result.body: Peel the accessible brim to admit air; keep opening movements small. Support the drain block without levering on the rod.

pages.source: Funnel-mold/README.md: cast and open step 5

pages.title: Pull the rod and trim flash
pages.subtitle: Support the silicone block while sliding the straight steel rod out.

actions.title: Withdraw the straight rod
actions.body: Support the block and slide the released steel rod out along its axis. Peel the silicone from it if needed.

actions.title: Trim the accessible collars
actions.body: Cut lower-seat flash flush with the block bottom and guide overflow flush with the bowl throat. Trim port and vent flash.

actions.title: Keep the bore intact
actions.body: Leave the cylindrical 6 mm wall smooth. Clean the rod and guide openings before the next casting.

result.title: READY
result.body: The straight outlet is open end to end, its edge is clean, and the flat bearing face is intact.

pages.source: Funnel-mold/README.md: opening, rod withdrawal and flash trim

pages.title: Inspect and clean the funnel
pages.subtitle: A complete casting has a continuous ramp, an open straight bore and an intact bearing face.

actions.title: Inspect every wetted surface
actions.body: Look for pinholes, bubbles, tack, tears and coating transfer. Inspect the straight bore and both trimmed outlet ends.

actions.title: Clean with the qualified process
actions.body: Release traces and residue must be removed. The finished silicone, black pigment and post-process need the wetted-surface qualification.

actions.title: Check its actual installation
actions.body: The block bears on the cradle's hook tops. Its 6 mm bore grips the 6.35 mm LLDPE drain stub. Check seating, lift-out and leaks.

result.title: HOLD FROM FOOD SERVICE
result.body: No qualified bake schedule or finished-mixture food-contact result is recorded. A cured, attractive part alone does not close that gate.

pages.source: Funnel silicone.md; funnel-mold/README.md; wetted-surface-test.md

pages.title: Prepare the three foam pours
pages.subtitle: Two cap cavities and one body cavity use the acquired FSD 2 lb closed-cell PU foam.

drawing.value: body / open top, all at once

actions.title: Use the acquired foam
actions.body: FSD B08R7TX8QJ two-part 2 lb closed-cell PU. Mix the two parts 1:1 in measured shots, one shot per pour.

actions.title: Stage three separate pours
actions.body: Each cap pours bolted to the shell's top face; the body pours last through its open top. A build fills ~5 L of risen foam (~4 L cavity + waste), about 1/7 of the 1 qt kit.

actions.title: Stage a dry, ventilated bench
actions.body: Use dry cups/tools, protective gloves and chemical eye protection. Keep moisture out of the liquids and vapors away from the operator.

result.title: GLOVES ON
result.body: The PU foam's isocyanate component is a skin sensitizer. Clamp each cap before mixing its shot.

pages.source: Cold-core.md steps 3 and 6; BOM foam row; FSD official foam page + SDS

pages.title: Clamp each cap mouth-up
pages.subtitle: Use the shell's top face as the pour fixture for both cap stacks, one after the other.

drawing.value: 10 x M3 x 25 through lid + cap
TOP: flat lid underside / 4 deck inserts first
BOTTOM: counterbore pads face into the cup

actions.title: Label TOP and BOTTOM
actions.body: The top cap carries conduits and four deck-mount columns. Press the four full-length RX-M3x5.7 inserts into those columns before pouring.

actions.title: Use installed shell threads
actions.body: Ten full-length M3 inserts in the shell's top face supply the pour-clamp threads. Lid and cap have clearance holes.

actions.title: Build the correct stack
actions.body: Cap floor down on the shell. Bottom lid pads enter the cup; top lid underside is flat. Close with ten M3 x 25 screws.

result.title: CHECK
result.body: The lid is held by the complete screw pattern, not its own threads. All top-cap conduits and both vent paths remain open.

pages.source: Cold-core.md step 3; foam-shell/README.md cap stack; heat-set geometry record

pages.title: Pour the two cap cavities
pages.subtitle: Liquid enters through the lid's 20 mm hole and air leaves through both vents.

drawing.value: TOP 12.6 mm / BOTTOM 16 mm pour depth
top-cap section / one stack at a time

actions.title: Mix 1:1
actions.body: Mix the two parts 1:1 with the clamped cap ready beside you, and pour as soon as the shot is mixed.

actions.title: Pour into the 20 mm hole
actions.body: Keep the two 6 mm vents clear while foam expands. The lid stays clamped; do not cover the vent paths to force fill.

actions.title: Cure, trim, unbolt, repeat
actions.body: After cure, trim pour/vent overflow to the plate, never into a cradle. Remove the ten screws and repeat for the other labeled cap.

result.title: PRESERVE THE TOP FEATURES
result.body: Trim flush without cutting a valve cradle, conduit, anchor or deck-mount feature. Every conduit bore stays open end to end.

pages.source: Cold-core.md step 3; foam-shell/README.md cap pour

pages.title: Seal the copper exits; protect access
pages.subtitle: Everything foam will bury is installed, routed and proved before the body pour.

drawing.value: Seal the annulus before pouring foam

actions.title: Prove the buried work
actions.body: Carbonator and inlet jet qualified; coil/probes/reeds and fitted fluid lines checked. Tug-test inaccessible push fittings before encapsulating.

actions.title: Form, inspect and seal the exits
actions.body: Feed bare tails through their holes while lowering the core. Support broad bends in the copper; reject kinks or flattening. Burnish foil collars to clean copper and shell around both annuli.

actions.title: Keep service paths open
actions.body: Protect reservoir vent/fill openings, top conduits, relief outlet and both reed channels. Reed columns are installed after body foam cure.

result.title: PROBE AND ACCESS CHECK
result.body: Both probes and lead entries need foam coverage without a trapped void. Do not bury an unproved sensor, line, relief path or fitting.

pages.source: Cold-core.md steps 1, 5-6; foam-shell/README.md

pages.title: Pour through the open top
pages.subtitle: The body foam fills around the sealed carbonator and reservoirs; its connected zone reaches the coil.

drawing.value: OPEN +Z TOP / no cap during the pour
CORAL = foam zone / sealed vessel interiors take no foam

actions.title: Mix the body shot 1:1
actions.body: Mix 1:1 and pour all at once into the open +Z top, with no lid and no down-channels. The cap stacks are already poured separately.

actions.title: Pour directly into the body
actions.body: One pour fills the connected outer gap and space around the carbonator/coil, through the open paths at the reservoir-pocket ends.

actions.title: Watch fill and squeeze-out
actions.body: Preserve empty reservoir/reed cavities and open tube paths. Beads squeeze out at the lane slots and tight tube exits; trim them after cure.

result.title: A VOID AT A PROBE IS THE DEFECT
result.body: The pour must fully wet each probe and its lead entry. Trapped air condenses and frosts on the cold metal.

pages.source: Cold-core.md step 6; foam-shell/README.md body pour paths

pages.title: Trim and close the cold core
pages.subtitle: All three pours are cured before the gaskets and caps complete the insulated stack.

actions.title: Trim only cured overflow
actions.body: Trim to the plate, never into a cradle. Protect tubes/leads, copper exits, cradles and insert hosts; clear all conduits, vents and reed channels.

actions.title: Install reeds, gaskets and caps
actions.body: Drop reservoir reed columns in, route their cables out the top, and lay both TPU gaskets. Top cap rotates 180 deg; bottom mouth faces down.

actions.title: Close and inspect
actions.body: Ten M3 x 25 screws per end. Identify top orientation by deck/cradle features. Check open paths, gasket seating and recessed screw heads.

result.title: FINISHED
result.body: Both caps and body cured; exposed foam flush; probes wetted in with no void; channels and relief path open.

pages.source: Cold-core.md output condition + step 7; foam-shell/README.md
